boundaries: Actual pre-change package created SQLite reservations and command receipts; new package successfully replays absent and explicit-null binding requests and legacy activation receipts.
The shared _evaluate runs within _command BEGIN IMMEDIATE for both admit and activate.
Current-policy invalidation rejects activation even after replaying an old admitted receipt.
True access cannot elevate worker/reviewer/check/adviser. False access reaches unknown-quota conservative reserved-slot checks.
No provider calls, credentials or product/Git mutations.
limitations: This is the assigned Standards axis only, not the independent Spec review.
The lower capacity API still accepts legacy requests without expected_capacity by design; production builder must always supply controller-derived bindings.
Capacity receipts do not authorize real model activation and do not prove cross-database atomicity.
